title: Damage propagation modeling for aircraft engine run-to-failure simulation
authors: Saxena, A.; Goebel, K.; Simon, D.; Eklund, N.
venue: 2008 International Conference on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM)
evidence_quote: A health index was defined as the minimum of several superimposed operational margins at any given time instant and the failure criterion is reached when health index reaches zero.
role: defines the C-MAPSS generator and the health-index-to-failure convention that our lifespan scale T depends on

title: Metrics for offline evaluation of prognostic performance
authors: Saxena, A.; Celaya, J.; Saha, B.; Saha, S.; Goebel, K.
venue: International Journal of Prognostics and Health Management 1(1):4-23
evidence_quote: Currently, prognostics concepts lack standard definitions and suffer from ambiguous and inconsistent interpretations.
role: origin of the asymmetric NASA score and of the late/early reporting convention we audit

title: Review and Analysis of Algorithmic Approaches Developed for Prognostics on CMAPSS Dataset
venue: Annual Conference of the PHM Society 6(1)
evidence_quote: Among the 70 papers, only a few actually used the testing datasets for evaluating their methods. A mix of different datasets and the metrics used to evaluate performance was observed from the survey.
role: nearest prior work on C-MAPSS benchmarking inconsistency; our difference is engine-level resolution rather than reporting conventions

title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science
evidence_quote: we find 17 fields where leakage has been found, collectively affecting 294 papers and, in some cases, leading to wildly overoptimistic conclusions.
role: taxonomy we use to classify the two defects found in our own estimator (temporal leakage + constant fallback)

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters
authors: Henderson, P.; Islam, R.; Bachman, P.; Pineau, J.; Precup, D.; Meger, D.
evidence_quote: Without significance metrics and tighter standardization of experimental reporting, it is difficult to determine whether improvements over the prior state-of-the-art are meaningful.
role: precedent for seed variance and significance reporting; supports our variance decomposition design

title: Accounting for Variance in Machine Learning Benchmarks
authors: Bouthillier, X.; Delaunay, P.; Bronzi, M.; Trofimov, A.; Nichyporuk, B.; Szeto, J.; Sepah, N.; Raff, E.; Madan, K.; Voleti, V.; Kahou, S.E.; Michalski, V.; Serdyuk, D.; Arbel, T.; Pal, C.; Varoquaux, G.; Vincent, P.
evidence_quote: variance due to data sampling, parameter initialization and hyperparameter choice impact markedly the results.
role: methodological basis for treating seed and split as variance components rather than noise

title: Long Short-Term Memory Network for Remaining Useful Life estimation
authors: Zheng, S.; Ristovski, K.; Farahat, A.; Gupta, C.
venue: IEEE Conference on Prognostics and Health Management
evidence_quote: In this work, we propose a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) approach for RUL estimation, which can make full use of the sensor sequence information
role: method-side C-MAPSS baseline (LSTM line); cited so SS2 can describe the field without endorsing the reported gains

title: Remaining useful life predictions for turbofan engine degradation using semi-supervised deep architecture
authors: Ellefsen, A.L.; Bjørlykhaug, E.; Æsøy, V.; Ushakov, S.; Zhang, H.
evidence_quote: The advantages of the proposed semi-supervised setup have been verified on the popular C-MAPSS dataset.
role: second method-side C-MAPSS baseline (semi-supervised deep architecture); the comparison practice our resolution argument applies to

title: An operating condition classified prognostics approach for Remaining Useful Life estimation
authors: Li, Q.; Gao, Z.B.; Shao, L.Q.
venue: International Conference on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM)
evidence_quote: This paper presents a prognostics approach based on operating condition for estimating the Remaining Useful Life (RUL).
role: peer-reviewed precedent treating operating condition as an explicit modelling variable; the confound our decomposition holds fixed

title: A power primer
evidence_quote: The sample sizes necessary for .80 power to detect effects at these levels are tabled for eight standard statistical tests
role: source of the required-n / power relation behind the minimum detectable effect in SS3; keeps the MDE machinery from being self-invented

title: Show Your Work: Improved Reporting of Experimental Results
authors: Dodge, J.; Gururangan, S.; Card, D.; Schwartz, R.; Smith, N.A.
evidence_quote: we demonstrate that test-set performance scores alone are insufficient for drawing accurate conclusions about which model performs best
role: evidence that single test-set scores are insufficient for ranking models; our engine-level MDE is the C-MAPSS analogue

title: A Step Toward Quantifying Independently Reproducible Machine Learning Research
evidence_quote: We take the first step toward a quantifiable answer by manually attempting to implement 255 papers published from 1984 until 2017
role: precedent that reproducibility is measured rather than asserted; motivates the artefact+sha256 evidence standard

title: Remaining useful life estimation in prognostics using deep convolution neural networks
authors: Li, X.; Ding, Q.; Sun, J.-Q.
evidence_quote: Time window approach is employed for sample preparation in order for better feature extraction by DCNN. Raw collected data with normalization are directly used as inputs to the proposed network
role: representative window-based deep baseline on C-MAPSS; used in Section 2 to describe the field, never for its reported numbers

title: Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences (2nd ed.)
evidence_quote: Statistical Power Analysis is a nontechnical guide to power analysis in research planning that provides users of applied statistics with the tools they need for more effective analysis.
role: source of the 1.96/0.84 convention behind the MDE formula in Section 3

title: Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement (JCGM 100:2008)
authors: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology (JCGM/WG 1)
evidence_quote: Clause 5.1.2 gives the law of propagation of uncertainty: the combined standard uncertainty u_c(y) is the positive square root of the combined variance obtained from the variances and covariances of the input estimates.
role: the uncertainty-combination model used in section 4.6 (quadrature sum, coverage factor k=2)

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
authors: Bai, S.; Kolter, J. Z.; Koltun, V.
evidence_quote: Our results indicate that a simple convolutional architecture outperforms canonical recurrent networks such as LSTMs across a diverse range of tasks and datasets, while demonstrating longer effective memory.
role: origin of the TCN baseline used in E11; also the source of the claim that convolutional and recurrent families are comparable, which section 4.2 tests on C-MAPSS

title: Attention Is All You Need
authors: Vaswani, A.; Shazeer, N.; Parmar, N.; Uszkoreit, J.; Jones, L.; Gomez, A. N.; Kaiser, L.; Polosukhin, I.
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30 (arXiv:1706.03762)
evidence_quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
role: origin of the Transformer baseline used in E11

title: On the use of cross-validation for time series predictor evaluation
evidence_quote: No practical consequences of the theoretical flaws were found during our study, but the use of cross-validation techniques led to a more robust model selection.
role: external support for using k-fold cross-validation instead of a single holdout on engine-level time series (section 3, section 4.2)
